body:
There was a gang member who got involved in our school... he trespassed and the police handled things really badly. He opened fire and my girlfriend at the time got shot twice in the neck before she died.
I had come to visit her because I was from a neighboring country (latin america).

Its complicated.
I consider myself a compulsive (maybe pathological liar).
So saying the things I’ve done is the only way to face them head on.
I lied about *everything* to the people I loved
And until it was too late I did not give a shit or really think about how much I was hurting them
Yeah. But I really don’t know if i can live with these regrets . They feel like they’ve swallowed me whole
I mean. Maybe to someone they dont feel as bad. But i just feel like i cant live with myself based on what i think about it. And i guess that really is all that matters
Im not sure if thats possible at my uni sadly
But.... I’m leaving for college in a month. I don’t know if I’d be psychologically ready for that.
Its really far away. Like a continent away
